description: Stdlib delegation registry ratchet (ceval.jac delegate_modules): pure-C/heavy modules resolved through the single host-delegation registry instead of ad-hoc proxies or in-VM execution; host CPython 3.14 oracle parity pinned in test_stdlib_delegate.jac

modules.notes: named groups/backrefs, compile objects + flags, search/findall/split/sub/subn/fullmatch, M|S|I flag combos, byte-exact re.error text
date/datetime/timedelta arithmetic, isoformat/strftime, replace, comparisons, total_seconds; tz classes exposed but unpinned
compress/decompress round-trip, compressobj/decompressobj streaming, crc32/adler32, byte-exact zlib.error text
hexlify/unhexlify/a2b_base64/crc_hqx, byte-exact binascii.Error text via except binascii.Error class-proxy lane
uuid5/uuid3 determinism, UUID parsing/fields/int round-trip, namespace constants
